verdict.rationale: Grafana documents a vendor agent, Grafana Alloy, for collecting and shipping logs, plus OpenTelemetry-based collection of metrics, logs, traces and profiles. It also has dedicated Kubernetes monitoring and AWS/Azure/GCP cloud-provider monitoring experiences, and a community user describes sending logs from a k8s cluster. However, the evidence only shows Alloy for logs, and host and container instrumentation is never explicitly covered. Missing for 10: explicit host/node and container instrumentation evidence, documentation of Alloy or agent-based metrics and trace collection, a catalog of vendor-maintained integrations, and hands-on corroboration of cloud-service integrations.
